style.backgroundSystem: flat seamless #FFFFFF studio field for the packshot, flat #E9EAF0 panel for every infographic screen, one low-key #1C1C1E surface band reserved for the closing screen; no gradients, no textures, no random scenery

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent editorial cool-tone eye-makeup ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of studio field #FFFFFF, panel #E9EAF0, ink #1C1C1E and one accent #6E6AA8; cool neutral 5500-6000K studio light with a soft front-left key, bounce fill and one soft contact shadow grounding every object, no flare; one modern geometric sans-serif with Chinese copy always set as 「」-bracketed at headline 28-32pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt and no dense body text; thin single-weight line icons, hairline leader lines, circular magnifier viewports, numbered circles in #6E6AA8 and one curved connector arc as the only infographic components; flat backgrounds only, no gradients, no scenery; the product keeps one stable slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side angle with identical scale and label placement, eye-area imagery cropped to brow-and-lash-line only, skin left with real pore texture; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no invented numbers, durations, multipliers or test data
no identifiable face or full-eye beauty portrait
style.presentationRules: the product holds one stable slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side angle with identical scale, height and label placement on every screen; eye-area imagery is always cropped to brow-and-lash-line only with no readable identity; hands are optional, relaxed and anatomically correct; skin keeps real pore texture and is never smoothed
